newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, TRADED VOLUME RISE.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, TRADED VOLUME RISE.

text.p: Turnover rose to 2.810 million denars at Thursday's session of the Macedonian stock exchange from 22,500 denars at the previous session last Thursday as two companies' stocks traded, the exchange said.
Investbanka Skopje sold 36 shares on the second floor at 3,050 denars, up 360 from last close and below par of 3,094 denars.
ADOR Macedonia Skopje made its debut on the third floor, selling 270 stocks at par of 10,000 denars.
Traded volume was nine shares last Thursday.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
